mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates compress equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days as investors shift from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% signals labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as corporate earnings face demand contraction.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as economic growth decelerates.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) combined with low rates (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%) creates monetary policy dilemma, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS < 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Robust industrial production growth (INDPRO > 100) indicates strong manufacturing activity, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through profit expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 100.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth below 2.0% signals economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as recession risks increase.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 < 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS > 100k) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) supports consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 100k and UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Low rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) with accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.0%) signals unsustainable monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 2.0%.
